source.document: TBS2000B Series Oscilloscope Specification and Performance Verification (077-1538-03 Rev D)
source.pages: Model overview p. 10, specifications pp. 10-16, performance verification pp. 19-26
source.note: Limits read from rendered page images and recomputed from the specifications pp. 11-13. Equipment table p. 19 (DC source 17.5 mV to 7 V +/-0.5 %, leveled sine 50 kHz and 200 MHz +/-3 %, time mark 10 ms +/-10 ppm) is met here by the calibrator scope option.
deviations: Bandwidth reference at 50 kHz and 10 us/div instead of 1 kHz and 400 us/div (p. 23 steps 13-14): the calibrator leveled sine starts at 50 kHz (equipment table p. 19 also says 50 kHz).
Vertical offset accuracy (pass/fail by eye, p. 24) is recorded as the MEAN voltage the scope measures with limits of the source +/- 0.2 division.
Time base edge position is measured from the waveform record instead of by eye (p. 25 step 15).
Self test is started remotely (p. 22 steps 3-8 done by commands); its completion is awaited with BUSY?, which the manual does not document for the self test.
owner: 2026-10-25: 50 kHz / 10 us/div bandwidth reference approved (the manual prints 1 kHz).
2026-10-25: the 5560A / 5522A scope outputs deliver +/-45 V into 1 MOhm: the calibrator drives the 5 V/div offset points.
2026-10-25: offset recorded as a measured voltage, limits source +/- 0.2 div: approved.
2026-10-25: no HIGH VOLTAGE confirmation before the +/-45 V points.

sections.title: Self test and signal path compensation
Sample rate and delay time accuracy

points.desc: Self test (Utility > Diagnostics > Self Test, 1 loop: passed)
points.note: p. 22: started remotely (DIAg:LOOP:OPTion ONCE, DIAg:SELect ALL, DIAg:STATE EXECute = Loop 1 Times), end awaited with BUSY? (not documented for the self test), result DIAg:RESUlt:FLAg? / LOG?. The scope must have run 20 minutes first.

points.desc: Signal path compensation (Compensate Signal Paths: passed)
points.note: p. 22: all probes and cables removed first; repeat if the temperature changes by more than 10 degC. Run remotely with *CAL?, confirmed with CALibrate:RESults:SPC?.

points.desc: CH1 bandwidth: 3 V p-p reference, Vpk-pk at the model frequency
points.note: Owner-approved (2026-10-25): 50 kHz reference at 10 us/div; the manual prints 1 kHz at 400 us/div. p. 23: 500 mV/div, trigger coupling Noise Reject, source = channel under test, 50 ohm feedthrough terminator. The reference is set at 50 kHz, not the 1 kHz of step 14: the calibrator leveled sine starts at 50 kHz, which is also the equipment table frequency (p. 19); shown at 10 us/div instead of 400 us/div so a few cycles fill the screen. Model frequency 70 / 100 / 200 MHz (step 16) at 10 ns/div.

points.desc: CH1 offset +0.8 V, 200 mV/div, trace at -5 div: +1.8 V in
points.note: Owner (2026-10-25): the 5560A / 5522A scope outputs deliver +/-45 V into 1 MOhm, so the calibrator drives every offset point. p. 24: the trace must be within 0.2 division of the centre line (pass / fail in the test record); recorded as the MEAN the scope measures, limits = source +/- 0.2 div x 200 mV/div = +/- 0.04 V. Specification p. 11: +/-0.195 div here.

points.desc: Time base: rising edge of the 1 ms marker at 1 ms delay, from the centre line (divisions)
points.note: 1 division of displacement = 10 ppm time base error (p. 25 note); +/-2.5 div = +/-25 ns. Edge position measured from the acquired waveform, not by eye. The equipment table (p. 19) lists a 10 ms time mark; the procedure (step 2) uses 1 ms, which is used here.
